**Team:** Solbee Kim (Coordinator), Evandro M. S. Gomes, John Vasconcelos

## Who did what
- **Solbee Kim:** coordinated; set up the repo folder (`hackathon_2`), data loading and cleaning, the shared year-filter `reactive()`, theme and color palette, Chart 9 (scatter), and the documentation file.
- **John Vasconcelos:** Chart 18 - Bubble chart, contribution to project's folder organization and integration with the prior implementations by Solbee.
- **Evandro M. S. Gomes:** Chart 2  

## How the parts were combined
Everyone worked in one repo and committed their own work. Each chart plugged into the shared `ui`/`server` skeleton and reused the same `filtered_data()` reactive and palette, so all three charts show the same year's data.

## What we did better together
One person set up the data and theme, so the chart builders could work in parallel. Teammates caught errors in each other's code. The charts look consistent.

## What we would do differently
We would have liked to have more time to discuss how to make the charts more visually appealing and sophisticated.
